lessons.title: -पेक्षा (-pekṣā) — than, and the most
lessons.gloss: than — comparing two things, and सर्वात, the most

segments.source: [PAUSE 2s]

segments.text: Say "I want to go to Pune". (malā puṇyālā jāycaṁ āhe.) Then "fast". (jalad.)
गाडी बसपेक्षा जलद आहे. gāḍī baspekṣā jalad āhe. — "The train is faster than the bus."

-पेक्षा (-pekṣā) goes on the thing you compare against, in its bent form: घर becomes घरापेक्षा (gharāpekṣā), चहा becomes चहापेक्षा (cahāpekṣā). The adjective stays as it is; Marathi needs no "-er". For a quantity, add जास्त (jāsta, "more") or कमी, "less": मला चहापेक्षा दूध जास्त आवडतं (malā cahāpekṣā dūdh jāsta āvaḍtaṁ), "I like milk more than tea".

blocks.title: You'll want to know: सर्वात, 'the most'

segments.text: मीरा वर्गात सर्वात उंच आहे. mīrā vargāt sarvāt uñc āhe. — "Meera is the tallest in the class."
सर्वात (sarvāt) is "of all": सर्वात मोठा (sarvāt moṭhā), "the biggest"; सर्वात जवळ (sarvāt javaḷ), "the nearest".

lessons.title: तीन वर्षांपासून (tīn varṣāmpāsūn) — how long
lessons.gloss: for three years (and still) — how long, with पासून, पर्यंत and -भर

segments.source: [PAUSE 2s]

segments.text: Say "the train is faster than the bus". (gāḍī baspekṣā jalad āhe.) Then "from" and "until". (pāsūn, paryant.)
मी तीन वर्षांपासून पुण्यात राहतो. mī tīn varṣāmpāsūn puṇyāt rāhto. — "I have lived in Pune for three years."

Marathi keeps the present: the living still goes on. -पासून goes on the stretch of time, in its bent plural: वर्ष becomes वर्षांपासून (varṣāmpāsūn), तास becomes तासांपासून (tāsāmpāsūn). To ask: तुम्ही किती दिवसांपासून इथे आहात? (tumhī kitī divsāmpāsūn ithe āhāt?), "How long have you been here?"

blocks.title: You'll want to know: from … until, and all … long

segments.text: मी सकाळपासून संध्याकाळपर्यंत काम केलं. mī sakāḷpāsūn sandhyākāḷparyant kām kelaṁ. — "I worked from morning until evening."

-पासून … -पर्यंत frames a finished stretch. -भर, as in दिवसभर, fills it: दिवसभर पाऊस पडत होता (divasbhar pāūs paḍat hotā), "it rained all day". A bare number of hours needs no ending: मी दोन तास वाचत होतो (mī don tās vācat hoto).
